Pork Barbecue.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten. Pork. Banana ketchup, calamansi, soda add no listed allergen. No chilli.

Chicken Barbecue.note: Same soy sauce marinade; chicken, no pork or alcohol, so halal from ingredients at a 'none' branch.

Isaw.note: Chicken intestines; vinegar dip with bird's eye chilli on the side = chilli condiment, 1. Halal from ingredients.

Chicken Inasal.note: Marinade has no allergen; the soy sauce dip on the side is a default component = soy + gluten. Chilli dip on the side = 1. Annatto chicken oil, no pork.

Liempo.note: Soy sauce; breadcrumbs in the liver sauce = gluten; pork. Black pepper only, 0. Sold out in extra.json.

Pork Sisig.note: Mayonnaise = egg; soy sauce = soy + gluten; pork. Stated spicy. Chicken liver is no listed allergen.

Chicken Sisig.note: Mayonnaise, soy sauce; chicken only, halal from ingredients. Stated spicy.

Chicken Adobo.note: Soy sauce; vinegar, garlic, bay, peppercorns. No chilli.

Kare-Kare.note: Peanut sauce = peanuts; bagoong alamang (shrimp paste) on the side is a default component = crustaceans; sautéed with pork fat, so not halal although the meat is beef. Toasted rice has no gluten.

Sinigang na Baboy.note: Patis = fish; pork ribs. Long green chilli, stated mild = 1.

Sinigang na Hipon.note: Prawns = crustaceans; patis = fish. No pork. Stated mild.

Lumpia Shanghai.note: Wheat wrappers; egg in the filling; minced pork. Sweet chilli sauce on the side = 1.

Pancit Canton.note: Wheat egg noodles; prawns; soy sauce; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (g). Chicken, no pork: halal from ingredients.

Turon.note: Wheat wrapper stated egg-free; banana, jackfruit, sugar. Tagged vegan.

Arroz Caldo.note: Patis = fish; boiled egg; chicken. No chilli.

Pancit Palabok.note: Shrimp gravy; wheat-flour thickener; egg; smoked fish flakes; ground pork and chicharrón.

Halo-Halo.note: Evaporated milk, ube halaya and ube ice cream = milk; leche flan = egg + milk. Pinipig is rice. No gelatine (nata de coco, kaong are not).

Leche Flan.note: Egg yolks, condensed and evaporated milk.

Buko Pandan.note: Cream and condensed milk = milk. Gelatine of unstated source: not vegetarian, not halal (rule n).

Calamansi Juice.note: Calamansi and cane sugar by default; honey is a paid option.

San Miguel Pale Pilsen.note: Barley malt beer = gluten; alcohol = not halal; vegan as v7 Asahi.

Barbecue Platter.note: Union: pork and chicken skewers (soy sauce), garlic rice, atchara, vinegar dip with chilli (1). Pork = not halal.

Inasal Meal.note: Chicken Inasal with its soy dip (soy + gluten), garlic rice, atchara, iced tea. Chilli dip = 1. Halal from ingredients.
